why: The table had NO date column of any kind (12 physical columns, season bigint the only chronological axis). glue_call: glue.update_table(DatabaseName='leviathan_dev', TableInput=<desired silver_ams_cotton_quality with the 13th column appended>)  # additive; equivalently the ALTER above
